question: If 20% of a number is added to 72, then the result is the same number. 70% of the same number is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Given: Number + 20% of number = Number − 72 shifted

Actually: 0.2x + 72 = x ⇒ 0.8x = 72

x = 90

70% of x = 0.7 × 90

= 63

**∴ Answer = 63**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number + 72 = the number

**Formula used:**

Percentage = value/100 × number

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the number = x

⇒ 20% of x + 72 = x

⇒ (20/100)x + 72 = x

⇒ 0.2x + 72 = x

⇒ x − 0.2x = 72

⇒ 0.8x = 72

⇒ x = 72 ÷ 0.8

⇒ x = 90

⇒ 70% of x = (70/100) × 90

⇒ = 63

**∴ The correct answer is 63.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Formula

x% of a number = (x/100) × number

Equation Formation

Translate word statements into algebraic equations.

Shortcut Concept

If 20% added gives original, remaining 80% equals given value.

Fraction Conversion

20% = 1/5 and 70% = 7/10
